# Do Phylogenetic analysis

```{r}
extract_pp1_tree <- function(file_path) {
  library(ape)
  library(stringr)

  # Step 1: Read file
  tree_raw <- readLines(file_path)
  tree_text <- paste(tree_raw, collapse = "")
  tree_string <- sub("^.*tree [^=]+ = \\[&R\\] ", "", tree_text)

  cat("=== Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 2: Extract [&label="..."]: blocks
  label_pattern <- "\\[&label=\"(.*?)\"\\]:"
  label_matches <- str_match_all(tree_string, label_pattern)[[1]]
  cat("=== Raw Label Match Count ===\n")
  cat(nrow(label_matches), "metadata blocks matched\n\n")

  if (nrow(label_matches) == 0) stop("No valid metadata blocks found.")

  cat("=== First Metadata Block ===\n")
  cat(label_matches[1, 1], "\n\n")

  # Step 3: Extract pp1
  label_blocks <- label_matches[, 2]
  pp1_values <- sapply(label_blocks, function(x) {
    str_match(x, "pp1=([0-9\\.]+)")[, 2]
  }) |> as.numeric()
  cat("Extracted", length(pp1_values), "pp1 values\n\n")

  # Step 4: Clean tree string
  clean_tree_string <- str_replace_all(tree_string, label_pattern, ":")
  cat("=== Cleaned Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(clean_tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 5: Read tree
  tree <- tryCatch(
    {
      read.tree(text = clean_tree_string)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Error reading tree:\n", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (inherits(tree, "multiPhylo")) {
    cat("Tree is multiPhylo — using the first tree.\n")
    tree <- tree[[1]]
  }

  if (!inherits(tree, "phylo")) stop("Failed to parse tree properly.")

  # Step 6: Check internal nodes
  num_internal <- tree$Nnode
  cat("Tree has", num_internal, "internal nodes\n")

  # Step 7: Assign pp1 values
  if (length(pp1_values) < num_internal) {
    warning("Fewer pp1 values than internal nodes. Padding with NA.")
    pp1_values <- c(pp1_values, rep(NA, num_internal - length(pp1_values)))
  } else if (length(pp1_values) > num_internal) {
    warning("More pp1 values than internal nodes. Trimming.")
    pp1_values <- pp1_values[1:num_internal]
  }

  tree$node.label <- as.character(pp1_values)
  return(tree)
}
```

```{r}
tree <- extract_pp1_tree("Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree")
```

```{r}
# --- Root tree ---
tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Zhuliangomyces_illinitus", resolve.root = TRUE)

# --- Fortify and add support ---
tree_data <- ggtree::fortify(tree)
tree_data$support <- NA
internal_nodes <- which(tree_data$isTip == FALSE)
tree_data$support[internal_nodes] <- as.numeric(tree$node.label)

# --- Base plot ---
p <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.6) %<+% tree_data +
  geom_tree(aes(color = support)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#000000", mid = "#ff0000", high = "green",
    midpoint = 0.40, na.value = "black"
  ) +

  # Tip labels with space (no clipping)
  geom_tiplab(
    size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
    align = TRUE, linesize = 0.3, offset = 0.03
  ) +

  # Internal support values
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & !is.na(support) & support > 0.6,
      label = round(support, 2)
    ),
    hjust = -0.4, size = 2.5, color = "#317000"
  ) +

  # Layout fixes
  theme_minimal() +
  expand_limits(x = 1.1) + # force extra space on the right
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10) # top, right, bottom, left
  ) +
  labs(color = "ASTRAL pp1 Support")

```

# Prep combination of Morphometic and Phylogenetic data

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Clean species names for matching
# -------------------------------

tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_trim() %>%
  stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
  gsub("'|\"", "", .)  # Remove quotes if present

```

```{r}

# Merge all
df <- pca %>% left_join(vol, by = "species") 

# -------------------------------
# Summarize morphometric + climate data per species
# -------------------------------
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_volume_estimated)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species")

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Match tree tips and data
# -------------------------------
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))
cat("Species matched between data and tree:", length(species_in_both), "\n")

# Optional: Save unmatched species for review
unmatched_data <- setdiff(rownames(df_clean), tree$tip.label)
unmatched_tree <- setdiff(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))
writeLines(unmatched_data, "unmatched_data_species.txt")
writeLines(unmatched_tree, "unmatched_tree_species.txt")

# Prune tree and data to matched species
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))
df_pruned <- df_clean[species_in_both, ]
df_pruned <- df_pruned[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, rownames(df_pruned)), ]
stopifnot(rownames(df_pruned) == tree_pruned$tip.label)

```

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Match tree tips and data
# -------------------------------
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))


tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))
# Add a small branch length to avoid singularity
tree_pruned$edge.length[tree_pruned$edge.length == 0] <- 1e-8
node_backup <- tree_pruned$node.label
tree_pruned$node.label <- NULL

df_pruned <- df_clean[species_in_both, ]

# Ensure order matches
df_pruned <- df_pruned[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, rownames(df_pruned)), ]
stopifnot(rownames(df_pruned) == tree_pruned$tip.label)

df_pruned$species <- rownames(df_pruned)

# -------------------------------
```

```{r}
# === Load location data and Köppen raster ===

loc <- read_csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

# Remove rows with missing lat/lon
loc_clean <- loc %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lat_machine_readable), !is.na(Long_machine_readable))
loc_sf <- st_as_sf(loc_clean, coords = c("Long_machine_readable", "Lat_machine_readable"), crs = 4326)

# === Load raster before using it ===
koppen_raster <- terra::rast("Analyses/weather_and_geography/Climate_zones_phylogeny_morphology/koppen_geiger_tif/1991_2020/koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif")

# === Transform your spatial points to raster's CRS ===
loc_transformed <- st_transform(loc_sf, crs(koppen_raster))

# === Extract Köppen values ===
koppen_values <- terra::extract(koppen_raster, vect(loc_transformed))

# === Assign to data ===
loc_clean$koppen_code <- koppen_values[,2]

```

# Climate data analysis

```{r, label="climate_data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Transform projection to match raster
loc_transformed <- st_transform(loc_sf, crs(koppen_raster))

# Extract Köppen values
koppen_values <- terra::extract(koppen_raster, vect(loc_transformed))
loc_clean$koppen_code <- koppen_values[,2]

# === Optional: lookup Köppen labels ===
koppen_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  koppen_code = 1:30,
  koppen_label = c(
    "Af",  "Am",  "Aw",  "BWh", "BWk", "BSh", "BSk",
    "Csa", "Csb", "Csc", "Cwa", "Cwb", "Cwc",
    "Cfa", "Cfb", "Cfc",
    "Dsa", "Dsb", "Dsc", "Dsd",
    "Dwa", "Dwb", "Dwc", "Dwd",
    "Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd",
    "ET",  "EF"
  ),
  koppen_desc = c(
    "Tropical rainforest", "Tropical monsoon", "Tropical savannah",
    "Hot desert", "Cold desert", "Hot steppe", "Cold steppe",
    "Hot-summer Mediterranean", "Warm-summer Mediterranean", "Cold-summer Mediterranean",
    "Dry winter, hot summer (subtropical)", "Dry winter, warm summer (subtropical)",
    "Dry winter, cold summer (subtropical)",
    "Humid subtropical, hot summer", "Oceanic (marine west coast)", "Subpolar oceanic",
    "Continental, dry summer, hot", "Continental, dry summer, warm",
    "Continental, dry summer, cold", "Continental, dry summer, extreme",
    "Continental, dry winter, hot", "Continental, dry winter, warm",
    "Continental, dry winter, cold", "Continental, dry winter, extreme",
    "Continental, no dry season, hot", "Continental, no dry season, warm",
    "Continental, no dry season, cold", "Continental, no dry season, extreme",
    "Tundra", "Ice cap"
  )
)

# Add broad climate group
koppen_lookup$climate_group <- dplyr::case_when(
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("Af", "Am", "Aw", "As") ~ "Tropical",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("BWh", "BWk", "BSh", "BSk") ~ "Arid",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("Csa", "Csb", "Csc", "Cwa", "Cwb", "Cwc", "Cfa", "Cfb", "Cfc") ~ "Temperate",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("Dsa", "Dsb", "Dsc", "Dsd", "Dwa", "Dwb", "Dwc", "Dwd", "Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd") ~ "Continental",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("ET", "EF") ~ "Polar",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

loc_clean <- loc_clean %>% left_join(koppen_lookup, by = "koppen_code")

```

```{r, label="climate_summary", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# === Summarize: Most common climate zone per species ===
climate_summary <- loc_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species, koppen_label, koppen_desc, climate_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



```

```{r, label="merge_climate_data", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Merge with df_pruned ===

df_pruned <- df_pruned %>%
  dplyr::left_join(climate_summary, by = "species")


table(df_pruned$koppen_label, useNA = "ifany")


```

```{r, label="climate_data_plot", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Optional: replace NAs for visual clarity
df_pruned$climate_group <- ifelse(is.na(df_pruned$climate_group), "No data", df_pruned$climate_group)

# === Color palette for climate groups ===
climate_colors <- c(
  "Tropical" = "#1b9e77",
  "Arid" = "#d95f02",
  "Temperate" = "#7570b3",
  "Continental" = "#e7298a",
  "Polar" = "#66a61e",
  "No data" = "gray70"
)

# === Final plot ===
p_climate <- ggplot(df_pruned, aes(x = PC1_mean, y = avg_volume_estimated, color = climate_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = climate_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1 (Spore Shape)",
    y = "Estimated Volume",
    color = "Climate Group"
  )

# === Save ===
ggsave("climate_grouped_plot.jpg", plot = p_climate, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r, label="climate_data_plot", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# Step 1: Fortify + merge metadata
tree_data <- ggtree::fortify(tree_pruned) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pruned, by = c("label" = "species"))

# Step 2: Plot with climate colors and species labels
p <- ggtree(tree_pruned) %<+% tree_data +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = climate_group), size = 2) +
  ggtree::geom_tiplab(size = 2.5, fontface = "italic", hjust = -0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Tropical" = "#1f78b4",
      "Arid" = "#e31a1c",
      "Temperate" = "#33a02c",
      "Continental" = "#ff7f00",
      "Polar" = "#6a3d9a",
      "No data" = "grey60"
    ),
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  theme_tree2() +
  labs(color = "Climate Group") +
  ggtitle("Amanita Phylogeny with Climate Group and Taxa Labels") +
  xlim(0, max(tree_data$x, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)  # extra space for labels

# Step 3: Save plot
ggsave("phylo_climate_tree_with_labels.jpg", plot = p, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
